approach: Add a code_health module in athena-core. Pure functions measure files with syn (full, plus proc-macro2 span-locations): production lines = file lines minus #[cfg(test)] module spans, and longest function. 7-day churn comes from first-parent commits carrying an Athena-Job trailer. Failure citations come from Records. A threshold function yields breaches. Athena::code_health_after_landing(ui) queues one deduplicated structural-pass request per breached file through Athena::queue, counts landings since a new typed baseline record (AnyRecord::CodeHealthBaseline, athena.code-health-baseline/1), writes the baseline on the first landing with no review, and on the 10th landing after it queues a self-contained high-priority design review and writes a new baseline. The hook runs in Athena::land_pr after resync_onto_merge and the Pages watch, and in note_finished in steward.rs only for OutcomeState::Landed, placed before the nested-run early return. Errors are only logged as warnings. StatusView gains a code-health table that display.rs renders with aligned columns. Dependencies are pinned centrally in the root Cargo.toml [workspace.dependencies] and used as syn.workspace = true. All nested-run tests set the disk minimum to 0.

decisions.choice: Measure with syn 2.0.119 (features full, parsing, visit) and proc-macro2 1.0.107 (span-locations), declared in root [workspace.dependencies], used via .workspace = true in athena-core. Production lines = file lines minus cfg(test) module spans.
decisions.reason: Buy over build; exact spans and cfg attributes. Use the syn 2 major already in Cargo.lock so no third copy is added. Recorded in docs/decisions.md.

decisions.choice: A landing is a first-parent commit on HEAD whose message carries an Athena-Job trailer. The baseline stores the count; a review is due when current minus baseline >= 10. The same definition feeds the 7-day churn count. Recorded in docs/decisions.md.

risks.risk: Hook in land_pr breaks existing gh tests.
risks.mitigation: Hook only warns on error and skips when no Rust sources parse.

risks.risk: Real repo breaches on first run, queuing many requests.
risks.mitigation: Intended; dedupe keeps one per file; tests use fixture trees.

risks.risk: New AnyRecord variant breaks exhaustive matches.
risks.mitigation: Fix every match the compiler reports.

risks.risk: Nested-run tests hit the disk guard.
Dependency policy or xtask tests reject the new direct deps or features.

demonstrations.method: Unit test with fixture tree (cfg(test) mod, long and short fn), dated Athena-Job-trailer landings in a scratch git repo, fixture failed/rejected records.
demonstrations.observes: Production lines exclude the test module; longest fn, 7-day landings and citations equal known values.
demonstrations.fails_without: Test-module lines are counted, the longest function is wrong, or churn/citation counts differ.

demonstrations.method: Threshold tests: 2001-line file, 201-line fn, 1501 lines with 5 landings, plus under-limit and boundary files.
demonstrations.observes: Each breach is reported with its reason; small and boundary files are not flagged.
demonstrations.fails_without: Nothing is reported or the small file is flagged.

demonstrations.method: Scratch repo; run check, read Records, rerun, then with an open request present.
demonstrations.observes: Exactly one request citing the measured numbers; the rerun and open-request cases queue none.
demonstrations.fails_without: A second request is queued, or none exists.

demonstrations.method: Round-trip test in records.rs; core test writes the baseline on the first landing, then Records::load from git into a fresh StateDir.
demonstrations.observes: Record parses with the right path and schema; baseline survives reload; no review on the first landing.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the variant the baseline fails to parse/reload; without first-landing logic a review fires.

demonstrations.method: Set baseline, add 9 landings and check, then a 10th; min_free_gb 0.
demonstrations.observes: No review after 9; one high-priority request after the 10th, queued via Athena::queue; none again right after.
demonstrations.fails_without: An off-by-one queues on the 9th or misses the 10th.

demonstrations.method: Read the queued review text from Records and assert phrases.
demonstrations.observes: Names the code-health table, files most changed and most broken, open structural-pass requests, recent rejections and planning stops, and a short design note with proposed changes as a design-only job.
demonstrations.fails_without: A missing phrase fails the assertions.

demonstrations.method: Integration tests in code_health_hooks.rs plus a gh.rs unit test: land via land_pr (fake runner) and via note_finished, min_free_gb 0. For order, assert the Ui lines in sequence (resync, Pages watch, then the code-health line) and that the queued request's records commit follows the resync commit in git log of the records branch. A Rejected outcome test asserts nothing is queued.
demonstrations.observes: Both paths queue the request for a breaching file, in the stated order; Rejected queues none.
demonstrations.fails_without: Removing either hook leaves no queued request, failing that test; moving the hook earlier breaks the order assertion.

demonstrations.method: Render test builds a StatusView with rows and suite time and renders it in display.rs.
demonstrations.observes: Table has file, lines, longest fn, weekly landings, cited, limits, over columns and the suite time; header and cell columns align.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the table the header assertions fail.

demonstrations.method: Run the three checks on the finished change.
demonstrations.command: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked
demonstrations.observes: All three exit 0, including every new test and the new AnyRecord variant handled in all matches.
demonstrations.fails_without: A format slip, clippy warning, unhandled variant, stale Cargo.lock or failing test makes the chain exit non-zero.
